desc: Derive that a valid completion exists iff no white cell satisfies x_w <= x_b and y_w <= y_b for some black cell.
Implement the Python program with the dominance sweep (sort by row descending, black before white in same row, maintain max_y, O(M log M), no N-sized arrays).
Verify samples and edge cases (same-row black/white, equality in row/column, all black, all white, large N) and ensure output is Yes/No.
